name: Danish Open 2018
information: **Dette er Danish Open 2018, og konkurrencen vil også agere som det danske mesterskab! Danske statsborgere har muligheden for at vinde titler fra dette mesterskab.** Husk at læs hver eneste fane. Den danske version stå øverst hver gang, og så vil der være en engelsk version under den. ________ **This is the Danish Open 2018, and it will also act as this years Danish Championship 2018! Danish citizens will have the opportunity to win titles from this championship.** Please make sure to read all the tabs. English versions will be in the bottom of every tab, below the Danish version.
